conclusion.interpretation: V21 evaluates ONLY the lexicographically latest P2P-C*-terminal-report.md. Creating the C39 terminal report does not conceal any defect in the C38 report: the C38 report is frozen terminal truth and is no longer in the validator's scope. A defect in C38 would be 'hidden' only if the validator were expected to police all historical reports, which its code does not do.
conclusion.c38_v21_gaps: The C38 report lacks CANDIDATE_SHA256/CANDIDATE_LABEL because it predates the V21 checks (checks added in C29 68af45a, C38 report finalized e6b9d1d). These are PRE-EXISTING gaps, not regressions introduced by C39.
